medium confidence · Returns immediately for a null input or when the first 32-bit value is not 0x5b. medium confidence · Queries attribute-context selector 0x13 and returns the failure sentinel 0xfffffffe when its status is 8; validates a mode argument in the range 0..1, checks a second context status, builds a 30-entry table, and returns the selected entry only for an index below 30 (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:25369-25414).
